description: Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive: 11 captured tool responses cover 12 exact search strings (English, French, Arabic and local-news targeted searches), with most useful leads in Nouakchott. No systematic day-by-day or province-by-province newspaper archive access, and no complete search of regional cities/sectors has been established. Mixed-year/future results are frequent.
